Synthetic independent operating-point witnesses measured in SIMetrix Elements
9.40d. Constant and smooth limiter comparisons use 1 pV absolute plus 5e-11
relative tolerance (reference listing precision); semiconductor current
comparisons use 1 pA plus 0.1% relative tolerance for the native kernel.
The wrong-arity case must fail during preparation. No vendor models are included.

The three BJT temperature-precedence witnesses additionally require the
prepared legacy Gummel-Poon family. For their independent C test only, the
family is projected to C's native NPN/PNP selector; all temperatures and
transport fields are unchanged and the original 0.1% gate is retained.
Exact historical-constant constitutive checks belong to solver #266.
